_README: External benchmarks — the ONLY place a number about other golfers may live. The repo's rule (DECISIONS.md 2026-09-29, reversing the 2026-08 'Rejected: benchmarks'): an external average is printable only with a source URL, the population it was measured on, and the provider's definition of the metric, so the page can pair it with the record's own definition and say when they differ. `verified: true` means the page was read and states the number; `confidence` is about the source (primary data provider = high/medium, secondary write-up = low). `band` is the provider's own grouping (a handicap band, or a scoring band like '70s') — never mix the two. `checked` is the day the page was read. Edit by hand; `pnpm data:validate` enforces the contract.
